findings.highlight: "...Yes. I carried you there. Sakura told me to protect you. I merely obeyed her order, as her Servant."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……そうですね。貴方たちを運んだのは私です。サクラは貴方を守れと言った。私はサーヴァントとして、彼女の命に従ったまでです」
findings.governingReading: Rider confirms that she transported Shirou and the others from the forest to the church under Sakura's order.
findings.explanation: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.

findings.highlight: You are clumsy and inexperienced, but trustworthy at your core. That is how you have saved Sakura."
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方は未熟で不器用ですが、その芯にあるものは信用に足ります。だからこそ、サクラにとって貴方は救いだったのでしょう」
findings.governingReading: Rider says the trustworthy core beneath his immaturity is why he was/is a source of salvation for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.

findings.highlight: But her words are utterly sincere, coming from someone who shares her senses with her Master.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、マスターである桜と感覚を共有するライダーの言葉は紛れもない真実だ。
findings.governingReading: Because Rider shares Sakura's sensations, Shirou treats what she says as unmistakable truth.
findings.explanation: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.

findings.highlight: these last two years have been the happiest times of her life."
findings.evidenceJa: サクラにとっては、この二年間こそが幸福だった」
findings.governingReading: Rider says those two years themselves were happiness for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.

findings.highlight: What makes Sakura happy is having you by her side. She does not wish for anything else."
findings.evidenceJa: サクラの幸福は、貴方が生きて傍にいてくれる、という事。それ以外に彼女が望むものなどない」
findings.governingReading: Rider defines Sakura's happiness as Shirou living and remaining at her side, and claims she wants nothing else.
findings.explanation: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.

findings.highlight: ...I try to clench my unmoving left hand.
findings.evidenceJa: ……動かない左腕を握り締める。
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses his other hand to grip/clutch the left arm that will not move.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.

findings.highlight: That's why...if I stop here, then I'll have nothing left.
findings.evidenceJa: だから—ここでそれを止めてしまったら、俺は何者でもなくなってしまう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes that if he stops the Sakura-only fight he has chosen, he will become no one at all.
findings.explanation: Becoming nobody becomes merely having nothing left.

findings.highlight: She noticed that I couldn't give her a clear answer.
findings.evidenceJa: 答えを言えなかったのは、気付いてしまったからだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou could not answer because he himself had noticed what Rider's no-matter-what condition points toward.
findings.explanation: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.
